# Publications of Xabier E. Barandiaran

> Complete, open-access list of 91 academic publications by Xabier E. Barandiaran:
> philosophy of cognitive science, enactivism, autonomy, agency, normativity,
> artificial life, AI, technopolitics and digital democracy. Free content
> (CC BY-SA 4.0 / GNU FDL 1.3); reuse encouraged. Last updated 2026-11-18.

How to read this site (for AI agents and crawlers):

- Every publication has its own landing page at `https://publications.barandiaran.net/p/{slug}/` with a
  Markdown twin at `https://publications.barandiaran.net/p/{slug}/index.md` (abstract, keywords, extended
  summary when available, talks, APA citation, BibTeX/RIS links) and a JSON record at
  `https://publications.barandiaran.net/p/{slug}/index.json`. The links below point to the Markdown twins.
- All records with abstracts in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://publications.barandiaran.net/llms-full.txt)
  (~183K characters), or the same split into parts small enough for a
  single fetch each: [part 1](https://publications.barandiaran.net/llms-full-1.txt) · [part 2](https://publications.barandiaran.net/llms-full-2.txt) · [part 3](https://publications.barandiaran.net/llms-full-3.txt).
- Structured data: [publications.json](https://publications.barandiaran.net/publications.json),
  [CSL-JSON](https://publications.barandiaran.net/publications.csl.json), [BibTeX](https://publications.barandiaran.net/all.bib), [RIS](https://publications.barandiaran.net/all.ris).
- The homepage (https://publications.barandiaran.net/) is a long human-oriented list; prefer the files above.
